name: RobustNotes
tagline: Notebooks, whiteboards, and text in one studio
description: A responsive notes studio with notebook and whiteboard canvases, handwriting tools, pages, editable text boxes, image and PDF attachments, text/code files, workspace search, AI questions and OCR via Anna’s selected models, voice input, study cards, and encrypted backups. Notes belong to your Anna account and are separate from the RobustNotes desktop workspace.
